name: 42701 · Elizabethtown, KY
findings: ZIP 42701 (Elizabethtown) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42701 (Elizabethtown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 42701 (Elizabethtown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
